run_adsorption_energy_analysis: run the energy.py script to parse MOF adsorption energy data and generate parity plots
download_odac_data: download the ODAC large file group using fairchem.core.scripts.download_large_files.download_file_group
parse_adsorption_energy_txt: parse adsorption_energy.txt to extract MOF name, defect concentration, CO2/H2O counts, and adsorption energy
filter_promising_mofs: filter pristine and defective MOFs where CO2 adsorption energy is below -0.5 eV and lower than H2O adsorption
generate_parity_plot: generate a scatter plot comparing CO2 vs H2O adsorption energies for pristine and defective MOFs
